newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian FESCO says sees Jan-Sept losses.
newsitem.headline: Russian FESCO says sees Jan-Sept losses.

text.p: Russia's Far-Eastern Shipping Company (FESCO) had financial losses in the first nine months of this year, company Vice-President Mikhail Yakimenko said on Thursday.
He declined to specify the size of the losses, saying only that they were due to new accounting systems, problems with Arctic navigation and increased advance tax payments.
FESCO (AO Dalnevostochnoye Morskoye Parokhodstvo in Russian) reported pre-tax profits of 17.5 billion roubles in the first nine months of 1995.
The shipping company reported a pre-tax profit of 28.5 billion roubles in the first half of this year.
FESCO's charter capital is 16.4 billion roubles.
